P2: The name-based rule splits a tool name that a provider streams across unindexed deltas. A fragment with a name and no id starts a new call once the latest call has a name, but the lines below still concatenate `function.name` across deltas. For `{id:'call_a', name:'get_'}` followed by `{name:'weather'}`, this now yields two calls, `get_` and `weather`; before this change they merged into `get_weather`. The /v1/responses path avoids this by dropping the name rule, so decide on the same trade-off here, or limit the name rule so it does not split continuation fragments, and add a split-name test.
